title: Tip from Angela - Step Up to the Challenge
summary: A short motivational tip encouraging learners to treat self-doubt as a signal to prepare and take on bigger challenges.

concepts.heading: Key takeaway
points: Self-doubt when handed a demanding opportunity is common; preparing thoroughly and accepting the task is how skills grow.
Watch for moments of doubt paired with a request to step up, and treat them as growth opportunities rather than reasons to decline.
